tools.name: login
tools.description: Opens Winpot's existing login modal, fills username/email and password when provided, and submits through the modal if the form becomes submittable.

remember.description: Whether to remember the user on this browser, optional

submit.description: Whether to click the login button after filling credentials. Defaults to true only when both username/email and password are provided.

tools.name: search_games
tools.description: Search Winpot's public casino game catalog by name. Read-only, no login required. Returns matching game names, ids, and types.

query.description: Text to search for in game names

tools.name: view_info
tools.description: Returns links to Winpot's public help/info pages (terms and conditions, payment options, deposits, withdrawals). Read-only, no login required.

topic.description: Which info page to return. Omit to get all of them.
